verdict: Windows Update Agent scan against WSUS failed. The client cannot evaluate software update compliance until a scan completes.
fix: Check SoftwareDistribution corruption first: stop `wuauserv`, rename `%windir%\SoftwareDistribution` to `SoftwareDistribution.old`, restart `wuauserv`, then force a scan cycle (`Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName SMS_Client -MethodName TriggerSchedule -Arguments @{sScheduleID='{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000113}'}`). If scans still fail, verify the client can resolve and reach the WSUS server on its configured port (default 8530 HTTP / 8531 HTTPS).
